verdict.rationale: Sentry offers AI agent tracing and LLM observability, so an evaluation-scoring capability is a fair question for this kind of product. However, the evidence covers only tracing, dashboards, cost and token tracking, and conversation replay. Nothing in the pack documents evaluations, datasets, or custom code-based scorers or metrics.

support.subject: As an ML engineer, I can write custom code-based scorers and metrics for my evaluations
